title: 🏢 SAP Weighs Cutting 10,000 Jobs — A Full Restructure in the Name of AI!
body: 🏢 SAP Weighs Cutting 10,000 Jobs — A Full Restructure in the Name of AI!
SAP, the German software giant, is considering cutting at least 10,000 jobs as part of a new restructuring plan aimed at reshaping the company entirely for the age of artificial intelligence.
According to reports, the cuts could affect around 9% of the company's global workforce of more than 110,000 employees, with a particular focus on product development, engineering, and sales teams.
The move is part of the CEO's push to turn SAP into an "AI-first" company, with artificial intelligence at the heart of its software and a new way of developing and selling products.

The final number has not been decided yet, as it could change after negotiations with employee representatives, while the company said only that it continuously reviews its organization and workforce, and that no decisions have been made yet.
If the plan goes ahead, it would be the company's second major restructuring in about two years, following a similar move in 2024 that also covered around 10,000 jobs.
Simply put: AI is not just changing products — it is reshaping companies themselves; do you think AI will create new jobs as fast as it eliminates them?
Do you think big companies' shift toward AI will keep moving at this speed?
